title: Project Configuration Schema v1.5
description: Per-project pack definition (projects/{slug}/project.config.json). See ARCHITECTURE.md §10. v1.1 (Phase 10): additive bump — content_settings + brand_identity extension fields. v1.2 (Phase 11 W-F1 cascade fix): additive bump — singular 'profile' field (Foundational Principle 2 enforcement field for production skills new-blog/revise-content). v1.3 (v1.1 P0 ADR-030, Migration 0003): brand_identity additive rename — `pronoun_preference` (canonical, replaces deprecated `hitap`) and `formality` (canonical, replaces deprecated `tone`). Old keys retained as deprecated aliases under additionalProperties: false during 1-year shim window. v1.4 (Phase 3 G-AI-05, Migration 0004): bank entry enrichment fields (applicable_topics, phrasings, last_used_in_content_id, max_usage_per_month). v1.5 (v1.8 Phase 1 D-SF-12, Migration 0005): additive 'sf' block (optional) for Screaming Frog 24 native MCP integration — sf.mcp.{enabled,url,allowed_directory,crawl_config_path,max_wait_minutes,per_report_timeout_seconds}. v1.4 docs MUST be migrated via scripts/migrations/migration_0005_project_config_1_4_to_1_5.py before validation against this schema. 'profiles' array (plural, v1.0) retained for sf-required-reports Tier elevation; singular 'profile' added for Phase 10 Principle 2 profile-aware skill behavior switch. Required array UNCHANGED (additive policy, → rules/schema-versioning-discipline.md).

schema_version.description: v1.5 (v1.8 Phase 1 D-SF-12): additive 'sf' block for Screaming Frog 24 native MCP integration. v1.4 docs MUST be migrated via scripts/migrations/migration_0005_project_config_1_4_to_1_5.py before validation against this schema (ADR-018 strict const). Prior bumps: v1.4 added bank entry enrichment (Migration 0004); v1.3 renamed brand_identity hitap/tone → pronoun_preference/formality (Migration 0003); v1.2 added singular 'profile' field; v1.1 added content_settings + brand_identity extension fields. This is the config CONTRACT version (bumped only by scripts/migrations/* migration scripts), distinct from the ENGINE RELEASE version (e.g. v1.9.4): the two axes version different things — the per-project data contract vs the shipped engine/plugin tooling.

project_id.description: lowercase slug; matches projects/{slug}/ directory name

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country or region code (e.g. TR, NG). Resolution priority: project.config.market is the authoritative root (this field); defaults.market — if present in legacy overlays — is deprecated and MUST NOT be relied on by new skills (K11).

profiles.description: Composable project-type profiles (union + dedup + priority merge at runtime). Drives Tier elevation in sf-required-reports.

profile.description: Foundational Principle 2 — profile-aware enforcement primary field for Phase 11+ production skills (new-blog, revise-content, faq-optimization, content-remediation, generate-images). Phase 11 W-F1 cascade fix (Phase 10 EKSİĞİ closure). Skill behavior bu enum'a göre branch'lar: tone, word count, citation density, disclaimer, image style, author byline, counter-argument. Compose-time relation with 'profiles' array: when 'profile' is set, skills use it as the dominant Principle 2 switch; when omitted, skills derive a primary profile from 'profiles' (priority merge per content-quality.md Principle 2 tablo). Optional — additive only, required[] unchanged.

workspace_root.description: Absolute or ~-relative path to project pack root

language_code.description: ISO-like DataForSEO language code, e.g. 'tr', 'en', 'en-us', 'zh-Hant' — NOT a numeric locale id (codex-audit f4)

sf.description: v1.5 (v1.8 Phase 1 D-SF-12): Screaming Frog 24 native MCP integration block. OPTIONAL — required[] unchanged (additive policy). sf.mcp.enabled defaults false; when false the sf-crawl-orchestrator falls back to file-drop ingestion via existing sf-import skill (backward compat). Migration 0005 populates this block with default values; operator overrides per-project (D-SF-18 path parameterization).

enabled.description: Whether sf-crawl-orchestrator is allowed to invoke SF MCP for this project. False (default) = file-drop fallback only via existing sf-import skill. True = MCP-primary ingestion path (sf_crawl → sf_crawl_progress → sf_generate_report loop).

url.description: SF MCP HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint. D-SF-01 HTTP transport (only HTTP MCP in registry currently). D-SF-18 parameterized per-project for cross-machine portability.

allowed_directory.description: SF allowed directory for sf_generate_report save_report=true output. Verified at runtime via mcp__sf__sf_list_allowed_base_directory. Null = use SF GUI default. D-SF-03 isolation (SF scratch separated from PSEO workspace) + D-SF-18 parameterization.

crawl_config_path.description: Path to a .seospiderconfig file passed as crawl_config_file_path argument to sf_crawl. Null = use SF GUI default settings (no per-crawl override).

max_wait_minutes.description: Hard cap on the sf_crawl_progress polling loop duration before sf-crawl-orchestrator declares a DURUR (operator review required). Default 180 minutes covers a typical 30K-URL crawl.

per_report_timeout_seconds.description: Per-report HTTP timeout for individual sf_generate_report calls within the 24-report Tier 1/2 loop. Q-SF-MCP-11 resolved default 300s (covers worst-case large-report serialization).

niche.description: Short brand niche/sector slug (e.g. bebek-guvenlik-bakim). Free-form metadata for content-skill context. Added to properties so closing `brand` (P1-03) keeps accepting this real key used by live configs.

description.description: Human-readable one-line brand description. Free-form metadata. Added to properties for the same P1-03 reason as `niche`.

patterns.description: Case-insensitive substring patterns used by brand_vs_generic_split (§12.1)

brand_identity.description: Visual brand identity block consumed by the blog_render Tier 1 CSS injection (S11/SP4 Part 2) + Phase 10 content rules (R-23 inline CSS, R-100 brand entity sameAs, R-71/R-72 image style). Opt-in — projects without this block render with per-profile neutral defaults. All fields optional; a populated subset overrides the corresponding render-time slots while the rest fall back to per-profile defaults. v1.1 additive (Phase 10): tone, hitap, anglicism_tolerance, font_heading, font_body (legacy alias retained), default_hero_url, same_as_urls, image_style. v1.3 additive (ADR-030, Migration 0003): pronoun_preference (canonical, replaces deprecated hitap), formality (canonical, replaces deprecated tone) — old keys retained as deprecated aliases for 1-year shim.

tone.description: DEPRECATED v1.3 — use formality (Migration 0003, ADR-030). 1-year alias retain. Phase 10 legacy: profile-aware tone — YMYL=semi-pro+siz, e-commerce=conversational+sen, b2b-saas=formal+siz.

formality.description: v1.3 canonical (replaces deprecated tone). Profile-aware formality (Principle 2 tablo). Migration 0003 copies legacy tone value verbatim — values preserved (workspace KORUNUR).

hitap.description: DEPRECATED v1.3 — use pronoun_preference (Migration 0003, ADR-030). 1-year alias retain. Phase 10 legacy: Türkçe hitap formu — e-commerce sen, YMYL/b2b-saas siz.

pronoun_preference.description: v1.3 canonical (replaces deprecated hitap). Türkçe pronoun preference — Principle 2 profile-aware. Migration 0003 copies legacy hitap value verbatim — values preserved (workspace KORUNUR).

anglicism_tolerance.description: Phase 10. Anglicism (e.g. 'feature', 'workflow', 'brief') tolerance — düşük = pür Türkçe, yüksek = mixed.

tone_phrases_blocklist.description: Phase 10 R-118. AI signature words humanize blocklist (e.g. 'Aslında', 'Sonuç olarak', 'Özetle').

font_heading.description: Phase 10 alias for font_family_heading; new content_settings consumers use this short form.

font_body.description: Phase 10 alias for font_family_body; new content_settings consumers use this short form.

default_hero_url.description: Phase 10 R-77. Fallback hero image URL when generate-images skill skipped or in flight.

same_as_urls.description: Phase 10 R-100. Organization.sameAs schema array: Wikipedia, Wikidata, LinkedIn, sosyal medya brand entity binding.

image_style.description: Phase 10 Principle 2 image style boyutu: YMYL=clean-illustration, e-commerce=product-photo, b2b-saas=diagram-screenshot, local-service=location-photo.

content_settings.description: Phase 10 (v1.1 additive) — content rules engine settings consumed by Phase 11+ production skills (new-blog, revise-content, faq-optimization, content-remediation, generate-images). All fields optional; per-profile defaults apply when unset. Cross-link → rules/content-quality.md, content-html-discipline.md, content-seo-discipline.md, content-eeat-discipline.md, content-llm-discipline.md, content-update-discipline.md.

toc_strategy.description: R-31 TOC strategy. b2b-saas long-form sticky; e-commerce category none.

author_strategy.description: R-28 profile-aware author byline. YMYL byline-required, e-commerce none.

css_strategy.description: R-60 CSS strategy. Default inline (R-23 reuse).

indexnow_enabled.description: Phase 10. Bing IndexNow API auto-submit yeni/revize content URL'leri.

ai_training_optin.description: R-98. LLMs.txt opt-in. Default OFF, init-project kullanıcıya sorar.

video_integration.description: Phase 10. Video schema markup + render strategy.

internal_data_sharing.description: R-116. Internal data aggregate-only paylaşım izni. KVKK/GDPR.

external_uniqueness_check.description: R-117. Pre-publish content uniqueness check (paragraph shingling vs SERP top-10), threshold ≥ 70%.

applicable_topics.description: v1.4 R-121: topic relevance filter; empty = eligible everywhere.

phrasings.description: v1.4 R-121: rotation variants for same fact (anti-parrot).

last_used_in_content_id.description: v1.4 R-121: drift detection; last content piece that consumed this entry.

max_usage_per_month.description: v1.4 R-121: density cap; max times this entry may appear per month across content.

original_research_database.description: R-114. Original research bank-driven. Skill bu array'den lookup; uydurma research yasak. v1.4: 4 R-121 enrichment field added.

applicable_topics.description: v1.4 R-121: topic relevance filter; empty = eligible everywhere.

phrasings.description: v1.4 R-121: rotation variants for same fact (anti-parrot).

last_used_in_content_id.description: v1.4 R-121: drift detection; last content piece that consumed this entry.

max_usage_per_month.description: v1.4 R-121: density cap; max times this entry may appear per month across content.

experience_database.description: R-119, R-105. First-hand experience + expert quote bank-driven; skill bu array'den lookup. v1.4: 4 R-121 enrichment field added.

video_database.description: Phase 10. VideoObject schema markup için video bankası.

disclaimer_templates.description: R-51 profile-aware disclaimer template map (key=cluster_kind 'medical'|'legal'|'financial', value=HTML/markdown template). YMYL profile'ında zorunlu inject.

image_model.description: R-72. Default image generation model. Plugin agnostik (Higgsfield veya equivalent), per-project override.

pillars.description: Topical map root entities. Keys used in D-01 CSR invariant.

workflow.description: Runtime workflow toggles. SP0/EX1 (v1.1.0): quality_iteration gates the new-blog 5-pass iteration loop; default false until L3 quality_gate lands in S18. Flip to true alongside the v1.1 release that ships the real L3 implementation.

enabled.description: Enables the new-blog 5-pass threshold iteration loop. When false, new-blog writes the baseline draft after L1 profile-threshold validation and skips iteration. When true AND the quality_gate/citability_scorer MCP tools are no longer STUBs, the full loop runs.

rules_overlay.description: Path (relative to project root) to project-specific rules JSON that layers over plugin defaults

platinum_seo_core_version.description: semver constraint on the core plugin (e.g. ^1.0)
